ConnectionStrings._comment_DefaultConnection: REQUIRED while Database:Enabled is true: Database connection string

Database._comment_Enabled: false runs the service without a database: no connection string, migrations or readiness check; any query answers 503. The job server and an outbox bus go off with it

InternalApi._comment_ApiKey: System API key for inter-service communication, at least 16 characters. Empty: every call with an API key is refused

HangfireSettings._comment_Enabled: false runs no job server and no dashboard, and drops the settings below from validation
HangfireSettings._comment_DashboardPassword: REQUIRED while Enabled is true: Min 12 chars for Basic Auth validation

Cors._comment_AllowedOrigins: REQUIRED for production: Array of allowed origins for CORS
Cors._comment_AllowedMethods: OPTIONAL: Array of allowed HTTP methods (default: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, OPTIONS)
Cors._comment_AllowCredentials: OPTIONAL: Whether to allow credentials (cookies, auth headers)
Cors._comment_PreflightMaxAge: OPTIONAL: Preflight cache duration in seconds (default: 3600)
Cors._comment_AllowedHeaders: OPTIONAL: Array of allowed headers (if empty, allows any)
Cors._comment_ExposedHeaders: OPTIONAL: Array of exposed headers (if empty, allows any)
